name: test_execution
summary: Run and inspect Python tests through a bounded, asynchronous agent-safe interface.

ops.name: run
ops.summary: Start a bounded background test selection and return immediately.

ops.name: inspect
ops.summary: Read bounded temporary results without executing tests again.

ops.name: statistics
ops.summary: Estimate and inspect organization-local timing and outcome history.

notes: The deterministic projection is the Testing dashboard plugin. Machine capacity is coordinated separately because it describes one physical host; completed-run statistics are always owned by the authenticated caller's organization.
